title: Golden Gate Bridge
summary: The Golden Gate Bridge is a suspension bridge across the Golden Gate strait, the entrance to San Francisco Bay from the Pacific Ocean. Construction began on 5 January 1933 and the bridge opened to vehicles on 29 May 1937. It is 8,981 feet long including approaches, with a main span of 4,200 feet.

uncertainty.note: Start is 5 January 1933 per the bridge district; ASCE says construction began in November 1932. End is the vehicle opening on 29 May 1937 (the district page); ASCE lists completion as 1937.
